```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
if (!require("ejabT1E", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install ejabT1E: devtools::install_github(\"nathoogroup/ejabT1E\", subdir = \"ejabT1E\")")
}
diagnostic_qqplot <- getFromNamespace("diagnostic_qqplot", "ejabT1E")
```

```{r}
alpha = 0.05
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rpcb = read.csv("RP_CB Final Analysis - Effect level data.csv")
rpcb_df = rpcb[, c("Paper..", "Original.sample.size", "Original.p.value",
                    "Replication.p.value", "Original.test.statistic.type",
                    "Original.df1", "Original.df2")]
rpcb_df = rpcb_df[!is.na(rpcb_df$Original.p.value) &
                   !is.na(rpcb_df$Original.sample.size) &
                   !is.na(rpcb_df$Replication.p.value), ]
rpcb_df$replicated = ifelse(rpcb_df$Replication.p.value < alpha, 1, 0)
```

Pointwise C*(alpha) calibration
```{r}
# Uses estimate_Cstar_alpha from ejabT1E: at each alpha, C*(alpha) minimises
# (observed_proportion - alpha/up)^2 where proportion = count(p <= alpha AND ejab > C) / N.
# Produces adaptive C*(alpha) for each alpha on a grid.
```

Prepare data for EJAB method
```{r}
rpcb_df$p = pmax(as.numeric(rpcb_df$Original.p.value), .Machine$double.eps)
rpcb_df$N = as.numeric(rpcb_df$Original.sample.size)
rpcb_df$q = as.numeric(rpcb_df$Original.df1)
is_chisq <- rpcb_df$Original.test.statistic.type == "chi-squared" & !is.na(rpcb_df$Original.test.statistic.type)
rpcb_df$q[is.na(rpcb_df$q) & is_chisq] <- as.numeric(rpcb_df$Original.df2[is.na(rpcb_df$q) & is_chisq])
rpcb_df$q[is.na(rpcb_df$q)] <- 1
rpcb_df <- rpcb_df[!is.na(rpcb_df$q), ]

rpcb_df <- rpcb_df[rpcb_df$N > 1 & rpcb_df$q >= 1, ]

cat("Number of rows:", nrow(rpcb_df), "\n")
cat("p range:", range(rpcb_df$p), "\n")
cat("N range:", range(rpcb_df$N), "\n")
cat("q range:", range(rpcb_df$q), "\n")
```

Run pointwise C*(alpha) calibration and candidate T1E accumulation rate plots
```{r calibration, fig.width=14, fig.height=5}
up <- 0.1  # Upper threshold u_p

# Compute eJAB for all studies
rpcb_df$ejab <- ejab01(rpcb_df$p, rpcb_df$N, rpcb_df$q)

# Pointwise: estimate C*(alpha) for each alpha on grid
fit <- estimate_Cstar_alpha(rpcb_df$p, rpcb_df$ejab, up = up,
                            grid_range = c(0, 3), grid_n = 200, n_alpha = 200)

# C* at the chosen alpha
nearest <- which.min(abs(fit$alpha_grid - alpha))
Cstar <- fit$Cstar_alpha[nearest]

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))

# Panel 1: Candidate T1E accumulation rate (using adaptive C*(alpha))
plot(fit$alpha_grid, fit$proportions, type = "l", lwd = 2,
     xlab = expression(alpha), ylab = "Observed Proportion",
     xlim = c(0, up), ylim = c(0, max(fit$proportions, 1)),
     main = "Candidate T1E Accumulation Rate\n(Pointwise C*(alpha))")
abline(0, 1 / up, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topleft", legend = c("Observed", "Reference (slope 1/up)"),
       col = c("black", "red"), lty = c(1, 2), lwd = 2, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

# Panel 2: C*(alpha) vs alpha
plot(fit$alpha_grid, fit$Cstar_alpha, type = "l", lwd = 2,
     xlab = expression(alpha), ylab = expression(C^"*" * (alpha)),
     main = expression(paste(C^"*", "(", alpha, ") vs ", alpha)))
abline(h = 1, col = "grey50", lty = 3)

# Panel 3: Diagnostic QQ-plot at alpha
idx_t1e <- which(rpcb_df$p < alpha & rpcb_df$ejab > Cstar)
if (length(idx_t1e) > 0) {
  U_vals <- diagnostic_U(rpcb_df$p[idx_t1e], rpcb_df$N[idx_t1e], rpcb_df$q[idx_t1e],
                         alpha, Cstar)
  diagnostic_qqplot(U_vals, alpha = alpha, Cstar = Cstar)
} else {
  plot(1, type = "n", main = "No candidates", xlab = "", ylab = "")
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

cat("Pointwise C*(alpha =", alpha, "):", round(Cstar, 4), "\n")
```

Compute f, U diagnostic, and flag Type I candidates using pointwise C*(alpha)
```{r}
# f_i: the p-value threshold at which eJAB = C* for each study's (n, q)
rpcb_df$f <- 1 - pchisq(
  (2 * rpcb_df$N^(1 / rpcb_df$q) / (rpcb_df$N^(1 / rpcb_df$q) - 1)) * log(sqrt(rpcb_df$N) / Cstar),
  df = rpcb_df$q
)

# Diagnostic U_i = (p_i - f_i) / (alpha - f_i)
rpcb_df$U_diagnostic <- diagnostic_U(rpcb_df$p, rpcb_df$N, rpcb_df$q, alpha, Cstar)

# Flag Type I candidates: p < alpha AND eJAB > C*(alpha)
rpcb_df$type1_candidate <- (rpcb_df$p < alpha & rpcb_df$ejab > Cstar)
```

Summary and export
```{r}
# Summary
cat("\nType I candidates:\n")
print(rpcb_df[rpcb_df$type1_candidate, c("Paper..", "p", "ejab", "U_diagnostic", "replicated")])

# Compare replication rates
cat("\nReplication rate for Type I candidates:", 
    mean(rpcb_df$replicated[rpcb_df$type1_candidate]), "\n")
cat("Replication rate for non-Type I candidates:", 
    mean(rpcb_df$replicated[!rpcb_df$type1_candidate]), "\n")

# Export
write_csv(rpcb_df, "rpcb_pointwise_output.csv")
```

Ground truth comparison (using replication as proxy)
```{r ground_truth}
n_total     <- nrow(rpcb_df)
predicted   <- rpcb_df$type1_candidate
real_t1e    <- (rpcb_df$p < alpha) & (rpcb_df$replicated == 0)

n_real      <- sum(real_t1e)
n_predicted <- sum(predicted)
n_overlap   <- sum(real_t1e & predicted)

sensitivity <- ifelse(n_real > 0, n_overlap / n_real, NA)
n_not_t1e  <- n_total - n_real
n_true_neg <- n_not_t1e - (n_predicted - n_overlap)
specificity <- ifelse(n_not_t1e > 0, n_true_neg / n_not_t1e, NA)
n_false_pos <- n_predicted - n_overlap
ppv <- ifelse(n_predicted > 0, n_overlap / n_predicted, NA)

cat("## Ground Truth Comparison (Pointwise)\n")
cat(sprintf("- True T1Es (sig & did not replicate): %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_real, n_total, 100 * n_real / n_total))
cat(sprintf("- Predicted T1Es: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_predicted, n_total, 100 * n_predicted / n_total))
cat(sprintf("- Correctly predicted: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\n",
            n_overlap, n_real,
            ifelse(n_real > 0, 100 * n_overlap / n_real, 0)))
cat(sprintf("- False positives: %d\n", n_false_pos))
cat(sprintf("- Sensitivity: %.3f\n", sensitivity))
cat(sprintf("- Specificity: %.3f\n", specificity))
cat(sprintf("- PPV (precision): %.3f\n", ppv))
```

Diagnostic QQ-Plot with OLS fit and simultaneous confidence band
```{r diagnostic_qqplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=7}
sig_df <- rpcb_df[rpcb_df$p < alpha, ]
n_sig  <- nrow(sig_df)

type1_df <- sig_df[sig_df$type1_candidate == TRUE, ]
tp_df    <- sig_df[sig_df$type1_candidate == FALSE, ]

n_type1    <- nrow(type1_df)
n_true_pos <- nrow(tp_df)
rep_type1    <- mean(type1_df$replicated)
rep_nontype1 <- mean(tp_df$replicated)

cat(sprintf("Significant studies: %d\n", n_sig))
cat(sprintf("  Detected Type I errors: %d  (replication rate %.1f%%)\n",
            n_type1, rep_type1 * 100))
cat(sprintf("  True positives:         %d  (replication rate %.1f%%)\n",
            n_true_pos, rep_nontype1 * 100))

type1_u <- type1_df$U_diagnostic

png("rpcb_pointwise_diagnostic_qqplot.png", width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
qq_result <- diagnostic_qqplot(type1_u, alpha = alpha, Cstar = Cstar)
mtext(sprintf("%d detected Type I errors (pointwise)  |  replication rate %.0f%%",
              n_type1, rep_type1 * 100),
      side = 3, line = 0.3, cex = 0.85, col = "grey30")
dev.off()

qq_result <- diagnostic_qqplot(type1_u, alpha = alpha, Cstar = Cstar)
mtext(sprintf("%d detected Type I errors (pointwise)  |  replication rate %.0f%%",
              n_type1, rep_type1 * 100),
      side = 3, line = 0.3, cex = 0.85, col = "grey30")

cat(sprintf("\nOLS fit: intercept = %.4f, slope = %.4f\n",
            qq_result$intercept, qq_result$slope))
if (length(qq_result$outside) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("Points outside 95%% simultaneous band: %d\n",
              length(qq_result$outside)))
}
```
